title: 第13章 天元之力第14章 七宗三十六门
content_zh:
这男老师名为姜刚，在学院中主管学员后勤这一块，所以今日的宿舍分配由他来主持。就在刚刚，他才在殿堂里完成对宿舍记录的整理，准备回到自己的住处。路程中正好路过这一片宿舍区，发现前面有吵闹声，便走了过来。
看着高大山满脸是血，以及陆安也已经嘴角流出血迹，姜刚眉头一皱，心里的气就不打一处来。
“说话！是谁！”姜刚又是一声怒喝，在一片死寂的环境中仿佛一阵惊雷，吓得所有人都浑身一颤！
然而，依然没有人敢出来指证。
周成坤是星火城中鼎鼎大名的星火商会的少主，控制着整个星火城的拍卖会以及重要的资源，其他的商家再怎么强也需要星火商会的帮助，没有人会愿意因为两个穷人而得罪周成坤。
姜刚看着这一幕，眉头越来越深，这就是他很难处理的原因。没有人指证，他就没办法做出惩罚，他只是一个老师，做什么事都需要依据。
“姜老师，你别生气了。”周成坤一旁想了想，走上前笑着说道，“为两个穷人生气多不值得！而且一定是他们两个做错事，才会有人想惩罚他们，否则怎么别人不打，就打他们两个呢？”
姜刚闻言，立刻转头看向周成坤，眉头紧皱，目如秃鹫，顿时吓了周成坤一跳！
姜刚如何不知道，其实打人的主使肯定就是这周成坤，他也知道周成坤是谁的儿子，因为就在今天，星火商会还派人通过学院找到他，让他多多照顾。
姜刚虽然心中并不在乎什么星火商会，但学院却不得不在乎，更何况他有心处理，却没有任何一人敢出来指证！
“老……师。”突然一阵虚弱的声音传来，让姜刚眼神一怔，连忙转头看了过去。
周围的人也纷纷看去，只见陆安竟然挣扎着从地上爬了起来，捂着肚子缓缓站起。抹了一把嘴角的血后，看向姜刚，缓缓说道，“老师，我来告诉你是谁！”
周成坤见状一愣，跟着脸色一下子沉了下来！他没想到这小子挨了一顿揍后竟然还能站起来，忍不住开口说道，“小子，我劝你少说点话，以免祸从口出！”
“闭嘴！”姜刚猛地大喝，目光威严盯着周成坤，说道，“周成坤，你有没有把我放在眼里？”
周成坤见到姜刚真的动怒了，只好闭嘴什么也不说，只是盯着陆安看，眼神中透出阴狠的威胁。
陆安见到那眼神，丝毫不惧，嘴角甚至泛起一抹冷笑，身体一转，指着身后一名身穿蓝色衣裳的人说道，“他。”
跟着，又指向旁边一人，说道，“他。”
“他，他，他，他……”
在周成坤脸色铁青之下，陆安一连点了九个人，刚刚对他动过手的人一个未漏。而只见他点完一圈后，终于转过身来，目光冷漠看着周成坤，抬起手说道，“还有他！”
“你！”周成坤恼羞成怒，刚要大声喊道，却被更响亮的声音打断！

“闭嘴！”姜刚一声怒斥，吓得周成坤一下子闭上了嘴，只见他姜刚目圆瞪，大声吼道，“刚刚陆安点到之人，全都跟我走！”
那几个人见到姜刚像一头愤怒的狮子，吓得根本不敢违背，只好缓缓移动步伐跟着姜刚离去。只有那周成坤脸色阴沉仿佛能滴出水，回头看向陆安，咬牙说道，“你叫陆安是吧？今晚的事情，我会让你生不如死！”
陆安眉头微凝，眯着眼睛看着周成坤的威胁，目送这帮人离去。
等到这些人离去后，周围的人也一哄而散，此时从角落跑来一群人，正是今天交谈的李东石那群人。
“快！快把大山哥送到医务室！”李东石说道，连忙和别人一同抬起高大山，跟着回头看向陆安，着急问道，“你也和我去！”
“我没事。”陆安咬牙，捂着肋骨，缓缓摇头说道，“你们快去吧！”
李东石看了陆安一眼，叹了一口气，只能抬着高大山飞快往外跑去。
陆安见到李东石等人离去，也算是放下心来，刚想要转身往自己的宿舍走去，却被一道声音阻止。
content_en:
This male teacher's name is Jiang Gang, and he is in charge of student logistics in the college, so he is in charge of today's dormitory allocation. Just now, he had finished sorting out the dormitory records in the hall and was preparing to return to his residence. During the journey, I happened to pass by this dormitory area and noticed a noise in front of me, so I walked over.
Seeing Gao Dashan's face covered in blood and Lu An's mouth bleeding, Jiang Gang frowned and felt angry.
"Speak! Who is it!" Jiang Gang shouted angrily again, like a thunder in the dead silence, making everyone tremble!
However, no one dared to come forward to testify.
Zhou Chengkun is the young master of the famous Spark Chamber of Commerce in Spark City. He controls the auctions and important resources of the entire Spark City. No matter how powerful other merchants are, they still need the help of the Spark Chamber of Commerce. No one is willing to offend Zhou Chengkun because of two poor people.
Jiang Gang looked at this scene, his brows getting darker and darker, which was why it was difficult for him to deal with it. Without anyone to testify, he couldn't punish him. He was just a teacher, and he needed a basis for everything he did.
"Teacher Jiang, don't be angry." Zhou Chengkun thought for a while, walked up and said with a smile, "It's not worth being angry for two poor people! And it must be the two of them who have done something wrong, so someone wants to punish them. Otherwise, why would they beat the two of them instead of others?"
When Jiang Gang heard this, he immediately turned to look at Zhou Chengkun, his brows were furrowed and his eyes were like vultures. Zhou Chengkun was immediately frightened!
How could Jiang Gang not know that the instigator of the beating must be Zhou Chengkun, and he also knew whose son Zhou Chengkun was, because just today, the Spark Chamber of Commerce sent someone to find him through the academy and asked him to take care of him.
Although Jiang Gang didn't care about the Spark Chamber of Commerce in his heart, the college had to care about it. What's more, he wanted to deal with it, but no one dared to testify!
"Teacher." Suddenly a weak voice came, making Jiang Gang's eyes startled, and he quickly turned his head and looked over.
People around him also looked around and saw Lu An struggling to get up from the ground, holding his stomach and slowly standing up. After wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, he looked at Jiang Gang and said slowly, "Teacher, let me tell you who it is!"
Zhou Chengkun was stunned when he saw this, and then his face suddenly darkened! He didn't expect that this kid could stand up after being beaten, so he couldn't help but say, "Boy, I advise you to speak less, so as not to cause trouble!"
"Shut up!" Jiang Gang shouted loudly, staring at Zhou Chengkun with majestic eyes, and said, "Zhou Chengkun, do you take me seriously?"
Seeing that Jiang Gang was really angry, Zhou Chengkun had no choice but to shut up and say nothing. He just stared at Lu An with a sinister threat in his eyes.
Seeing that look, Lu An was not afraid at all. There was even a sneer at the corner of his mouth. He turned around and pointed at a man in blue clothes behind him and said, "Him."
Then, he pointed to the person next to him and said, "He."
"He, he, he, he..."
With Zhou Chengkun's face ashen, Lu An named nine people in succession, including none of the people who had just attacked him. After he finished clicking a circle, he finally turned around, looked at Zhou Chengkun with cold eyes, raised his hand and said, "There is still him!"
"You!" Zhou Chengkun became angry and was about to shout loudly, but was interrupted by a louder voice!
"Shut up!" Jiang Gang yelled angrily, and Zhou Chengkun was so frightened that he shut his mouth all of a sudden. Jiang Gang's eyes widened and he shouted loudly, "Everyone that Lu An called just now, follow me!"
Those few people saw that Jiang Gang was like an angry lion, and they were so frightened that they did not dare to disobey him, so they had no choice but to move slowly and follow Jiang Gang away. Only Zhou Chengkun's face was so gloomy that he could drip water. He looked back at Lu An and gritted his teeth and said, "Your name is Lu An, right? What happens tonight, I will make your life worse than death!"
Lu An frowned slightly and looked at Zhou with squinted eyes.Cheng Kun threatened and watched these people leave.
After these people left, the people around them also dispersed. At this time, a group of people ran from the corner. It was the group of people Li Dongshi was talking to today.
"Quick! Send Brother Dashan to the infirmary!" Li Dongshi said, and he quickly lifted up Gao Dashan with others, then looked back at Lu An and asked anxiously, "You come with me too!"
"I'm fine." Lu An gritted his teeth, covered his ribs, shook his head slowly and said, "You guys go quickly!"
Li Dongshi glanced at Lu An, sighed, and could only carry Gao Dashan and run out quickly.
Lu An was relieved when he saw Li Dongshi and others leaving. He was about to turn around and walk back to his dormitory, but was stopped by a voice.
